institutes.title: Institutes
institutes.password: Initial password (optional, OTP login works without)

notes.activate: The institute's users can sign in again.
notes.suspend: Blocks every user of the institute until it is activated again. For non-payment, suspend the subscription from Billing instead: that keeps billing and data export open.
notes.deactivate: Closes the institute: its users can no longer sign in. Its data is kept; use Data export & deletion to remove it.

institutes.impersonateNote: The session is time-limited and every action is audited.

edit.title: Edit institute
edit.intro: {slug} · The GSTIN and address are printed on this institute's SaaS invoices.

users.title: Users & devices
users.intro: Find any user on the platform to review the devices they are signed in on, or sign a device out.

plans.title: Plans
plans.limitsLine: Students {students} · Branches {branches} · Teachers {teachers} · Storage {storage} MB · AI {ai} tokens/mo

limits.aiTokensMonthly: AI tokens per month (0 = AI disabled)

plans.addonsHint: Packs institutes can buy on top of the plan. Recurring packs renew with the subscription; AI credit packs are one-time for the current month. A blank yearly price means 12 × monthly.
plans.usageHint: A limit normally blocks further use. Price a metric to bill usage above it monthly instead (seats: the month's peak, AI: the month's total), optionally up to a cap.

errors.moduleKey: Give each module add-on a module key (letters, digits, dashes)
errors.packSize: {label}: the pack size must be at least 1
errors.blockSize: {label}: the block size must be at least 1
errors.cap: {label}: the cap must be a whole number

ai.title: AI configuration
ai.cardTitle: AI provider (any OpenAI-compatible chat completions API)
ai.priceNotSet: Not set: cost is not estimated
ai.mockNote: The mock provider runs inside the API server: no key, no network calls.
ai.keyNote: The key is stored on the server and never sent back to the browser. Defaults come from env AI_BASE_URL / AI_MODEL / AI_API_KEY.
ai.envKeyNote: Currently using the key from the server environment.
ai.priceNote: Prices are used to estimate the cost of each AI call. Leave them empty to use the preset's list price.
ai.keyFromEnv: from env ({hint}) - enter a key to override
ai.removeMessage: AI features fall back to AI_API_KEY from the server environment, if set.

notices.mockBlocked: The mock provider is saved but cannot run in production, so AI features are off. Configure a real provider.
notices.mockSelected: The offline mock provider is active: AI grading, OCR and generated questions are simulated. Pick a real provider before going live.
notices.mockFallback: No API key is configured for {provider}, so AI features use the offline mock provider (simulated results). Add a key to use {model}.
notices.noKey: No API key is configured, so AI features are unavailable.
